info.title: API.SH: KuCoin
info.description: The KuCoin API from API.SH: public KuCoin data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Every currency KuCoin lists (or one): name, precision, margin flags and each chain with deposit and withdrawal status, minimums, fees, confirmations, contract address and memo rules. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-currencies

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Filter the list by code or name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Each currency's price in a fiat currency (USD by default), for every listed currency or the ones named.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-fiat-prices

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Fiat currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A KuCoin pair's candles (open, high, low, close, base and quote volume), oldest first, up to 1,500 a call. To page back, pass `next_end` as `end`; null when there is no earlier page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-klines

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start time, ISO date or unix time.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End time, ISO date or unix time.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Cross-margin trading pairs with their order size and price rules, and the margin settings: maximum leverage, warning and liquidation debt ratios, and the currencies usable as margin.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-margin

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Only pairs quoted in this currency.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only pairs whose symbol contains this.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A KuCoin pair's order book, 20 or 100 levels a side: price and size per level, best bid and ask and the spread.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-orderbook

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every KuCoin spot pair with base and quote currency, market, trading and margin flags, minimum and maximum sizes, price and size increments, minimum funds, fee category and coefficients.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-symbols

parameters.name: quote
parameters.description: Only pairs quoted in this currency.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Only pairs of this base currency.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Only this KuCoin market (USDS, BTC, ALTS ...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A KuCoin pair's last price, best bid and ask, 24-hour open, high, low, change, base and quote volume, average price and fee rates.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-ticker

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Trading pair as BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-USDT, ETH-BTC.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Tickers of every KuCoin pair in one quote currency, ranked by 24-hour volume, change (gainers and losers) or price: price, bid, ask, open, high, low, change, base and quote volume and fee rates.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-tickers

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A KuCoin pair's latest 100 trades, newest first: trade id, time, taker side, price and size.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kucoin-trades

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
